name: Water Gate
line: The Water Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, near Ophel, where the people gathered to hear God's Law read aloud and to celebrate a feast.

moments.title: Repairs near the Water Gate
moments.text: The temple servants living on the hill of Ophel repaired a section of the wall opposite the Water Gate toward the east.

moments.title: Ezra reads the Law
moments.text: All the people gathered in the square before the Water Gate and asked Ezra to bring out the Book of the Law. He read it aloud from daybreak until noon, and the people listened closely.

moments.title: Booths in the squares
moments.text: The people brought back branches and made booths, including in the squares by the Water Gate. They had not celebrated like this since the days of Joshua, and there was great rejoicing.
